sections.title: Chlamydia
sections.excerpt: A common sexually transmitted infection caused by Chlamydia trachomatis, often asymptomatic but associated with significant reproductive complications if untreated.

sections.excerpt: A sexually transmitted infection caused by the bacterium Neisseria gonorrhoeae, affecting the urogenital tract, rectum, pharynx, and eyes.

sections.title: Syphilis
sections.excerpt: A chronic sexually transmitted infection caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum. It progresses in stages and can involve multiple organ systems if untreated.
